title: Quenched Aerated Slovakian Spring Onions Pilaf
description: A romantic Slovakian dish featuring spring onions and a flambe finish, aerated for a light and flavorful experience.
instructions: Heat a skillet over a medium-high flame.
Add the unsalted butter and saut	6e until it melts.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly add in the sour milk, whisking continuously.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens.
Stir in the dijon mustard and remove the skillet from the heat.
Crack open the scallop shells and divide the pilaf mixture evenly between them.
Add a sprinkle of salt and black pepper to each shell.
Drizzle a spoonful of scallion oil over the top of each dish.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and a pinch of cayenne pepper.
Place the shells under the broiler and flambe with aquavit until golden brown.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Garnish with scallion slices, if desired.
Stir the pilaf to finish with a sprinkle of black pepper.
Drizzle a spoonful of sour cream over the top of each serving.
Sprinkle a pinch of ras el hanout over the top of each serving.
Stir the pilaf to combine.
Add a dollop of sour cream to the center of each dish.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and a pinch of cayenne pepper.
Serve immediately and enjoy!
Stir in the chopped parsley.
